items.title: Isekai Domination with the Overpowered Beautiful Secretary Thanks to My Unlucky Skill "Patent Rights"!
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 2 3   h o u r s ,   4 9   m i n u t e s
items.summary: The skill I received in another world was… “Patent Rights”!? Yuma Kujo, an otaku high school student, is transported to another world along with his entire class. Expecting to dominate this new world with an overpowered cheat skill, he is instead granted a mysterious ability called “Patent Rights.” Unable to figure out how to use it, his classmates deem him useless in battle and abandon him. Just then, a beautiful, highly capable secretary named Iris appears before him! Under her guidance, Yuma discovers the true power of his skill: he can monopolize the powerful magic spells he invents! Rise to the top with an underdog skill! An overpowered fantasy of magical invention and monopolization!!

items.title: the little alchemists repayment of gratitude
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   2 1   h o u r s
items.summary: The protagonist was sickly and bedridden, receiving little attention from his parents, and passed away at a young age. When he realized it, he had been reincarnated as the son of a noble family in another world. However, his hopes were quickly crushed when his parents abandoned him at just six months old. Was I destined to be unloved, both in my previous life and in this one…? Just as the protagonist was on the brink of despair, he was taken in by an alchemist named Jill, who was currently suffering from a severe creative slump. Jill gave the boy the name Noel and raised him with an abundance of love and affection. Determined to repay his new father’s kindness, Noel turns three. It is then that a strange voice begins speaking inside his head…? The heartwarming adventure of a beloved, genius little boy begins now…!

items.title: That legendary superweapon from history? That’s me

items.summary: 500 years ago, the world was engulfed in the Magical Great War. Amid the conflict, a special soldier—who had a combat AI called DEMON implanted in his head and a superweapon capable of destroying even mountains embedded within his body—dominated the battlefield. “Cross, stop looking down and pay attention! Are you even listening?!” Even if you tell me that, how am I supposed to look up…? Because the soldier shown in that historical footage from 500 years ago, fighting with the ferocity of a demon god… is none other than me!!

In a city rife with gunfire between gangs and public security, he takes on any assignment as long as he is paid, but stubbornly refuses to accept any request that involves killing people-a stance completely out of step with his past. Then, a request comes in from a revolutionary calling for liberation from corporations.

Warriors, Elementalists, Psychic Adepts… Powerful class users can split mountains and shatter peaks with a single strike, wielding power capable of destroying the heavens and the earth. Ye Xiao awakens the seemingly useless class of Lookout and is destined to live a miserable life. Just as his future seems hopeless, he unexpectedly binds himself to a God-Tier Eye Technique System. From then on, he transforms into the strongest Eye Technique Master and embarks on a path to rising from the bottom to the top!

Monsters and ferocious beasts roamed freely, while countless dungeons, secret realms, and abysses emerged. Within them lay opportunities to gain unimaginable power—but also to face unfathomable despair. Only by becoming a professional, leveling up, and growing stronger could one ascend to the supreme throne. On the day of his awakening, Wang Xingyu obtained the hidden class Shadow Mage and awakened a unique, god-tier talent: Shadow Monarch.

items.title: Blade of the Discarded

In an age where the fate of entire martial sects is decided through duels, prestigious clans secretly trade in human weapons known as “Shadow Fighters”—individuals trained to master and counter the martial arts of rival sects. Raised for a single purpose—to ensure victory—they are mercilessly discarded and erased from existence once their usefulness has ended. But those who were cast aside have not forgotten. Now, the forsaken rise to exact their revenge.

items.title: The World's Strongest Prodigy Returns to Defy Extinction
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   1 4   h o u r s
items.summary: Dungeons: mysterious labyrinths connecting our world to another dimension. Lured by the promise of limitless resources, humanity eagerly explored them—unwittingly triggering a monstrous invasion that pushed the world to the brink of extinction. To save humanity, the world’s strongest "Buster," Kiren Tsurugi, faced the cataclysm alone... only to vanish without a trace. Years later, a new wave of monsters attacks. But standing in their path is a single, mysterious young boy—a boy who bears a striking resemblance to the legendary Kiren.

items.title: Exiled Hero Picked Up by a Demon
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   3   h o u r s
items.summary: For nineteen years, Wel stood as the Holy Sword Hero, defending the Kingdom of Klenrad from monstrous threats. With just one year left before his retirement, betrayal struck from the shadows. Framed by the royal princesses, he was branded a criminal and exiled from the kingdom he bled to protect. Stripped of his name and honor, Wel vanished beyond the borders of mankind—into the lands of the demonfolk. There, he was taken in by Natalia, a fierce warrior of the Oni Tribe, and her daughter, Delilah. Wel began a new chapter among the demonkind, gradually finding peace as he built a quiet life in their village. As bonds grew between him, Natalia, and Delilah, the former hero who once stood at the forefront of war now embraced a life of warmth, healing… and the calm before whatever storm might come next.

items.title: The Illegitimate Son Became a Monster Summoner
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   1 3   h o u r s

On the brink of death, he hears the dark echoes of the chasm. Awakening a god tier talent called Dark Eclipse Echo, Kain returns from the dead. Armed with a summon that evolves from an ordinary monster into an epic calamity, he survives the abyss and embarks on a dark path of revenge to reclaim his honor.

items.title: Monster’s Streamer Star
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   3   h o u r s
items.summary: Born in a dark, damp cave, Squishy is a low-level slime with an ordinary fate ahead of him: to live and die as an insignificant monster. However, from the moment of his birth, Squishy was chosen by both magic and the system, awakening as an unusually intelligent slime alongside a livestream... And the world he encounters for the first time is far vaster and more wondrous than he ever imagined. *“I want to see it!”* Watching over Squishy are his dependable (?) viewers—Queen Squish, an overprotective Slime Queen, Cheeky Smartie, a lich who loves to tease but always makes sure to share useful knowledge, and even Arachne and Fenrir, who are so smitten with the adorable Squishy that they appoint themselves as his masters. As he travels the world in his tiny body, fighting, eating, and evolving, Squishy soon finds himself facing new adventures beyond anything he could have imagined. Here begins an adorable, harmless slime's chaotic journey of survival and exploration! Will Squishy survive unscathed and get to see the vast, wonderful world he's always dreamed of?

items.title: Howling (WANKE)
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   1 6   h o u r s
items.summary: Seoul has been devastated by the Howling Plague, a mysterious disease that transforms humans into monstrous beasts. Amid the chaos lives Rir, an unusually perceptive boy struggling to survive while caring for his sick younger sibling—the only family he has left. But when a mysterious incident erupts at the hospital, Rir’s desperate attempt to protect his sibling changes him forever. He awakens caught somewhere between human and beast, forced to confront the very plague that has destroyed their world. With everything he has left, Rir makes a promise: “I’ll bring you back. No matter what.” “Even if I have to become a beast myself.”

items.title: The Efficiency Freak's Isekai Speedrun
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 2 0   h o u r s ,   1 2   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Salaryman Kai Hayami is the ultimate efficiency freak, prioritizing optimization over absolutely everything else. Disgusted by the gross inefficiency of modern society, he relieves his stress by speedrunning "Love & Fantasy," an action RPG featuring perfectly obedient heroines. To Kai, it is the ideal world where logic and speed reign supreme! But after a fatal encounter with a truck, Kai wakes up inside the actual world of Love & Fantasy. Ready to execute the ultimate flawless speedrun using his vast gaming knowledge, his plans immediately crash. His commands do not work, the game is filled with bugs, and the supposedly docile heroines have transformed into aggressive, uncooperative powerhouses! Can this obsessed efficiency freak survive the chaos and clear a broken world where logic no longer applies?

items.title: Reborn as a Barbarian! Conquering Another World Starting from a Defeated Battle
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   9   h o u r s

In this story of rising to power, the protagonist is reincarnated as the chieftain of a defeated barbarian tribe, subjugated by a powerful empire. With their tribe on the verge of collapse after losing a war, the protagonist leads them in a fight to overthrow the empire and reclaim their freedom. A thrilling tale of ambition, strategy, and survival unfolds as they strive to build up their tribe and challenge the might of the empire!

Is the only way to survive and continue their love to fully wield the dragon's power? Will Minjun be able to overcome the limitations of his species and protect his passionate love with Sia?

Arriving in the bustling capital among legions of bloodthirsty warriors, a quiet young boy named Shu finds himself challenged by a man claiming to be the famed Demon Blade Slayer. But as blades clash and secrets unravel, the crowd is about to discover the shocking truth behind the boy’s real identity.

items.title: Sovereign of a Hundred Blades: Heir to the Strongest Style

No one knows what form the matches will take, but with a prize said to grant any wish, warriors from across the world gather. The story begins on the opening day of the Hundred-Blade Grand Melee, when a gentle, strangely young boy named Shu appears in the royal capital.

However, Evil King Zephia Kleban offers Kyo a Blessing in exchange for his own release. Kyo thus obtains the previously unknown “Evil King's Blessing.” The protagonist, once called the “weakest ZZZ-class,” is reborn as the “strongest ZZZ-class.” The rise-to-power fantasy begins now!

The hero Part and imperial mage Noah, dispatched to complete this mission. Together with Roro, a young shepherd boy they met at their final destination, they finally stand on the verge of completing the great plan. And on that day, everything was turned upside down.

items.title: Game Chishiki de Saikyou ni Natta Mob Heishi wa, Shin no Jitsuryoku wo Kakushitai
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   2   h o u r s
items.summary: A mob Soldier who was working as a Gate Guard — he turned out to be the strongest soldier?! One day, Silva realized that he reincarnated into a mob Soldier from the game that he was hooked on in his previous life. Even though he utilizes his game knowledge to do his utmost best to survive in this dangerous world, he opts to hide his true strength in order not to throw the scenario into disarray. However, an unexpected turn of events led to him easily defeating a huge demon that even the hero struggled with. And to make matters worse, he did that in front of his favorite heroine in the game... Upon this incident, word started getting out about his true strength...!! A heroic fantasy about the strongest soldier who will bring his full strength to bear for the sake of his favorite character is about to unfold!

items.title: Two Worlds: I Have an Ancient Martial Arts World

Han Lin, a student in the final year of high school in one of these cities, was doing his best in training in preparation for the 'College Entrance Examination'. In this world, universities are classified into: Tier 1 universities for the 'Immortal Gate', Tier 2 universities for the 'Divine Sect', Tier 3 universities for the 'Dao Academy'. Han Lin's ambition was initially modest, as he focused his choices on enrolling in one of the 36 universities belonging to the Divine Sect... but everything turned upside down when he discovered his ability to move to the world of High Martial Arts. From here, his ambitions and university goals began to take a completely different path."

items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   7   h o u r s
items.summary: In a world where mythical beasts roam freely, people can only grasp their longbows and devote themselves to the noble profession of hunting. A weapon hunter wields a weapon forged from hard gold, stone, and the essence of mythical beast minions, bound directly to his own life. As the hunter grows, so does his native weapon, granting him the power to slay even the strongest creatures. A gourmet hunter travels across the world in search of rare ingredients, drawing strength from exquisite food and forging the strongest bodies. The mightiest among them can even battle mythical beasts in close combat, meeting them head-on. A knowledge hunter seeks wisdom through books and uncovers forgotten history hidden within ancient ruins.

items.title: Mechanic: Slayer
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1 7   h o u r s ,   1   m i n u t e
items.summary: Twelve years ago, a mysterious goddess descended upon the world without warning, posing a single, chilling question to all of humanity: “Do you truly possess the worth to exist?” With that divine ultimatum, the world changed forever. Monsters burst forth from the shadows, and humans began awakening supernatural powers to fight back. In the chaos that followed, society fractured under the constant threat of annihilation. Three years later, Seo Haru is just an ordinary high school boy living an unremarkable life in South Korea. But that normalcy shatters overnight when an unexpected incident triggers his awakening—transforming him into the world’s only and ultimate Mechanic ability user. As the final awakened savior of humanity, Haru steps onto the battlefield alongside a loyal crew of companions. Facing towering monsters, hostile factions, and the crushing weight of the goddess’s impossible trial, the ultimate fantasy action chronicle of steel and survival begins. “Shall we get started then?” “Mechanic Slayer!”

He vows to struggle alongside his junior disciples to rebuild their martial home to its former glory. But something feels a little off. A roster made up of former beggars, mountain bandits, con artists, and thieves? Are they sure this is supposed to be a righteous Orthodox sect?

Shunned by the villagers and branded a monster for his merciless vengeance, he finds himself with nothing left to live for. With no attachment to life and no place to call home, "Yi-Se" sets out on a solitary journey... one driven not by hope, but by an unquenchable thirst for revenge. His vow is absolute: Every demon must perish. items.title: I'll Heal with an Academy Convenience Store
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   1 6   h o u r s
items.summary: I’m Lee Young-jin, twenty-nine years old, an orphan, and a master convenience-store clerk. I moved to Seoul with just five million won to my name and proved my worth working at a convenience store in Seongbuk-dong. Then, on the very night I was finally set to become the store’s owner, I was hit by a damn delivery truck and died… Or at least, I should have. Instead, I woke up inside the body of the villainous prince from the trashy game I’d been obsessed with. Now I’m Wolfram von Lohengrin—a prince, the former student council president who was kicked out of office, and a villain destined to get his head chopped off during the game’s intro. But dying again right after I’ve already died once? No thanks. Love and adventure can belong to the protagonists. From now on, my dream is simple: to become a convenience store owner in another world. Armed with the skills of a master convenience-store clerk and the absurd game knowledge of a hardcore veteran player, I’ll put my talents to work— and empty the pockets of everyone at the academy! The final key to it was the heart of the Red Dragon, Valdrova. “To think my own fiancée would come to take my life.” For some reason, Valdrova surrendered his heart willingly, without offering any resistance. "...What is this feeling? Why does it leave such a bitter aftertaste?" Ah, I saw it. Valdrova’s deep, ancient despair—a despair that my petty hatred couldn't even begin to compare to.

That orphan was Bright Fantasy’s protagonist, Isuka… His choice will greatly change the fate of the world.

items.title: Invincible Bodyguard
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   1 6   h o u r s
items.summary: A Fateful Encounter. Jang Cheon-woon was born the son of a third-rate martial artist. After losing his father and getting caught up with a gang, he struggles to survive a harsh life until one day he saves a dying old man by the river—Old Man Mu. After beginning to live with the old man, Cheon-woon starts having strange dreams every night. In these dreams, he learns martial arts from the old man, and he gradually begins growing stronger in the real world as well. One day, the Gucheonseong forces appear, having tracked down the old man. The old man, who had been hiding his identity, disappears, while Cheon-woon becomes entangled with them by chance and enters Gangryeonggok, Gucheonseong's martial arts training institution. Through intense competition and relentless training, Cheon-woon grows stronger. Despite being mocked and looked down upon, he gradually proves his abilities and earns recognition. Eventually, he is selected as the bodyguard of the Young Lord. But being a bodyguard isn't simply about protecting someone's life. It means surviving amid political schemes and deadly power struggles. Within Gucheonseong, factions seeking control of the sect begin to reveal themselves. The Young Lord senses the threats within, but the enemy's shadow has already reached deep inside. As Cheon-woon protects the Young Lord while becoming a target himself, he makes a decision: “I won't protect you by giving my life. I'll become invincible, never die, and protect you!” With internal traitors and outside forces joining hands against them, the Young Lord's life is placed in grave danger. Cheon-woon must now become more than a mere bodyguard—he must become a martial artist capable of carving out his own destiny. To survive the chaos engulfing him, he draws his sword.

items.title: The Regressionist and the Blind Saintess
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1 4   h o u r s ,   4 0   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Vera, who started out as a beggar, has no qualms about trampling on others or making despicable deals just to survive. Even in an era when the Demon King had emerged, he did not fight like a hero; instead, he hid in the deepest darkness, concerned only with preserving his own life. Though he managed to survive in the end, what awaited him upon his return after the war was karma. As he lay consumed by the curse, waiting for death, Vera did not even hope for anyone to be by his side at the end of his life, assuming no one would be there. However, when he opened her eyes, he found himself in a cesspool—and there, alongside him, was the blind saint Renée, who had been declared dead. Though René had a humble appearance, blind and covered in burn scars, she took Vera in with a heart more kind and selfless than anyone else’s. But she eventually died, and Vera was unable to prevent it. After his rebirth, he vows that this time, he will be the one to seek her out first and protect her at all costs. However, protecting René is not something that can be achieved simply by becoming stronger. On the day the Saint’s Stigmata manifest, the entire continent—from the Holy Kingdom and the Empire to the Kingdom Alliance, the Dragonians, and even the Followers of the Night—begins to mobilize around her.

items.title: Stella, the Princess Who Will Never Die
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1 8   h o u r s ,   4 6   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Princess Stella, the princess of the Hill Valley Kingdom, who lost her father, the king, is in the middle of a battle for succession. After receiving a will that leaves the throne and most of the king's fortune to Stella, her sister-in-law Ishjia plots to assassinate Stella. However, every attempt to assassinate Stella ends in failure. Ishjia finds this puzzling, but then she notices something strange happening to Stella's body... (Source: Natalie, translated)

items.title: I’ll Spend My Fortune to Become the Strongest Before the Game Ends
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1 4   h o u r s ,   3 0   m i n u t e s
items.summary: I poured my entire life savings into a game that was on the verge of shutting down. Everyone around me laughed, calling me a fool and saying I had completely lost my mind. But I am the only one who knows the truth: this game is about to descend upon reality. Using my skills as a hacker, I completely rewrote the code, setting all of my status caps to infinity. And when the game finally merged with the real world, I became an absolutely invincible existence.

items.title: Solo Swordmaster
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1 2   h o u r s ,   1 0   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Times change, and nothing lasts forever. Dragons and magic became legends, and heroes faded into the pages of history. It was now the age of players that were gifted immense power and skills by Constellations. “But is this power really free? …I protected this world for centuries, and this is what I get in return?!” I had all my assets seized and the only friend I had left killed. But now, humanity’s last Swordmaster—a man out of time—must pick up the blade once again to fight against a new threat to mankind—the arrival of constellations that now seek to invade the world. Will his new alliance with the longtime enemies of humanity, the Seven Princesses of the Seven Dragons Association, be able to defeat the very Constellations that bestowed humanity with their powers?

items.title: Miss Ji-Hye, The Uncool Adult
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 4   h o u r s ,   1 9   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Joo Yeon-ho works as a private academy instructor. One day, his former tutoring student Ahn Ji-hye — whom he hadn’t seen in four years — comes back into his life, completely unrecognizable from the girl he once knew. Unable to refuse due to circumstances, he finds himself reluctantly agreeing to an energy-draining cohabitation with her… The diligent and bright student he once remembered is nowhere to be found. Ji-hye has transformed into a total immature mess, acting like a carefree, irresponsible kid with no sense of adult responsibility! **Original Webtoon:** [Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=850746), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14168924)

items.title: Teto X Egen
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   6   h o u r s
items.summary: Haeseon, a driven "Teto girl" whose entire life revolves around her career, and Sunho, a quiet "Egen guy" who wants nothing more than to stay home with his cat. Living in entirely different worlds, the two were like parallel lines destined never to cross. That is, until they are forced onto the same Task Force team—and to make matters worse, they discover they live right next door to each other! As their daily routines become hopelessly entangled, Sunho's "first love" suddenly enters the picture...! What will become of this chaotic, nerve-wracking, and strangely heart-fluttering romance between two complete opposites? (Source: Millie ui Seojae, edited)

items.title: As a Member of the [Demi-God] Race, I Want to Live a Normal Life in Another World
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 5   h o u r s ,   1 3   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Saionji Ryoma, a young man, thought he was at home, but suddenly found himself in a strange hut. While he was confused, he suddenly received an email on his smartphone, which for some reason he had with him, from someone calling himself "the god of games and pleasure." To his surprise, in response to a wish that Reima had muttered, he was invited to another world. Not only did he have his smartphone equipped with cheat functions, but he also received the bonus of being transported as an ultra-rare species, a demi-god! Although confused, Reima is excited that he has "come to the other world he has dreamed of," and follows the tutorial displayed on his smartphone to head to the city. However, those around him do not miss him as a demigod!?

However, high risks yield the greatest rewards—especially when you possess the ultimate cheat code. To Wang Zhifan, even a minuscule 0.001% drop rate becomes a guaranteed [100%] success! Watch as this extraordinary player sweeps up every single reward and tears through the dungeons to conquer this apocalyptic world!

items.title: The Strongest Swordsman Rising from a Bottom-Tier Job
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1   d a y ,   9   h o u r s
items.summary: The Strongest Swordsman Rising from a Bottom-Tier Job In a world overrun by monsters, humanity fights back using special abilities gained through "Job Changes"—but a cruel hierarchy dictates their lives. It is a deeply divided society where those who wield magic rule as "masters," while those who swing swords are oppressed as mere "commoners." Born into this era, a young boy named Tatsuma Emori is entrusted with a single sword by his adoptive father, along with the directive: "Become the strongest." However, during the fateful "Job Change Ceremony," the rank handed down to him is a measly "D-Rank Swordsman"!? Despite being showered with mockery and ridicule, the indomitable flame burning in Tatsuma's eyes refuses to die out. With this sword, I will cut down the very system of this world. An unparalleled comeback battle fantasy about rising from the absolute weakest to the strongest!

items.title: The Sword Saint Reincarnated Into a Noble Mage Family
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1 5   h o u r s ,   1 6   m i n u t e s
items.summary: Xeno was a boy taken in by the Arclights, the empire's top swordsmanship clan. He sacrificed his life for the family, earning endless military glory as a Sword Saint—only to be betrayed and killed by Atlas, the family head he swore absolute loyalty to. But after dying in despair, Xeno wakes up reincarnated as a prodigy of the empire's greatest magic family, the Arclights' biggest rivals. To gain the power to crush Atlas, he starts his climb to the top at the meritocratic Royal Academy, showing off his overwhelming skills in both swordsmanship and magic!
